title: Vivacious Manipulations
subtitle: Animus — the animating force
text: Blood Rush (QUICK, 100): living blood naturally quickens the body. Blood Needle (CHARGED, 100; a Ferric memory): fire a burst of crystallized blood needles at range. Blood Shot (QUICK, 100): launch a single heavy blood projectile. Deadly Gaze (CHARGED, 100; a Ductilis memory): lock sight on a target and drain their vitality. Blood Cloud (QUICK, 300): erupt a cloud of blood mist that blinds and burns. Blood Aneurysm (CHARGED, 400): rupture a target's vessels internally. Crimson Flame (QUICK, 150; a Fervent memory): conjure a wave of burning blood-fire. Summon Thrall (QUICK, 500): raise a blood-fed fighter. Summon Avatar (PASSIVE, 75, with staged costs as the avatar grows): manifest a construct of living blood. Crimson Tithe (QUICK, 100) is Hemorath's Canon Memory, woven from his Hallowed Residuum: borrow 500 mL against his hunger for thirty seconds, and repay double whatever you spend.
